answer: Jurors stake 7% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The nectar panel is drawn blind, the prism escrow settles at close, and meadow lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 300 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
